description: Toast notification system CSS and container added to index.html
steps: Verify toast styles are present (.toast, .toast-icon, etc.)
Verify toast animation keyframes are defined

description: ToastManager JavaScript module implemented with show/dismiss methods

description: Toast notifications support 4 types: success, error, warning, info
steps: Verify each has distinct icon and color

Verify container is at bottom: 20px, right: 20px
